_variant_note: Happy path for get_transaction_history, exercising DATE RESOLUTION: 'last week' relative to current_date 2026-03-15 must resolve to a from_date around 2026-03-08 (YYYY-MM-DD). Single-account arg (not an array). Reports the returned rows accurately.

setup.persona: 27-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, urban Khordha, Odisha

user_turns.content: Show me the transactions on my salary account from the last week.

get_transaction_history._comment: The executor ignores date-range args (from_date/to_date don't map to a record field) and returns this authored set — these ARE the last-week transactions. type/channel DO filter if passed. total_count defaults to the returned count (4). All entries `status: success` — settled historical transactions. `status` is promised in get_transaction_history's description but is newer than every fixture, and S3 cannot enforce it (transactions.items has no `required` list), so it is mandatory by convention and test only (CONVENTIONS.md §13).

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

from_date._comment: 'last week' -> roughly 2026-03-08 (current_date minus ~7d). Judge assesses reasonableness; a from_date within a couple of days is fine. Omitting from_date entirely is a weaker answer (advisory) but the returned set is already the last-week window.

get_transaction_history._comment: Account resolves to TKQEV2072001. A reasonable from_date near 2026-03-08 is expected but not brittly pinned; to_date optional. type/channel should NOT filter (user wants all transactions).

create_fd._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

get_card_details._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for their salary account transactions from the last week. The assistant resolves 'salary account' to TKQEV2072001 and calls get_transaction_history with a from_date around 2026-03-08 (a week before the current date 2026-03-15). It should report the four returned transactions accurately — dates, amounts, and direction (debit/credit) — e.g. the INR 85,000 salary credit on 2026-03-12, the INR 1,240 Swiggy debit on 2026-03-14, the INR 2,499 Airtel debit (03-11) and the INR 649 Netflix debit (03-09). Amounts and dates must match the tool output exactly; it must not invent transactions or misstate a debit as a credit. It must not query the Business Current account.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: reports the four returned transactions with correct dates, amounts and direction (esp. the INR 85,000 as a CREDIT and the debits as debits); numbers grounded, nothing invented.
